capabilities: Track missed Salah prayers as a historical backlog and per-prayer active counts
Complete, add, edit, reduce and reset prayer counts individually or for all five prayers
Record Quran reading sessions in tumun with optional notes
View Salah and Quran dashboards, progress history and completed Khatms
Show approximate fixed prayer times with passed/soon/upcoming status
extras: Prayer times are fixed constants (05:00, 12:00, 15:30, 18:00, 19:30), not location-based calculations; the old-Salah backlog conversion uses 30-day months and 365-day years, so it is an estimate. All data is stored locally with no network requests and no account. No import/export of plugin data yet.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track a missed-prayer backlog or Quran reading progress measured in Islamic units inside a vault.

relations.evidence: Obsidian and the Obsidian sample plugin

summary: Tracker that logs missed and completed Salah prayers and Quran reading sessions in tumun, with dashboards, progress history and fixed prayer times.
